scientific_limitations: Exact M-matrix/Z-matrix classification for complete-six-edge IBEAM with bilinear/Wachspress coordinates on translated affine parallelograms in a Dirichlet grid of at least three cells per side, allowing independent positive edge factors and real Péclet labels. title: A sharp golden-ratio shape barrier for monotone edge-averaged convection–diffusion on parallelogram meshes
